numericEasingBound.validation: 20,001 points plus an analytic derivative bound between samples; mathematical curve only, not popup render certification

cleanupFollowUp.scope: One additional private Hyprland factor-0 case after restoring the pointer after focus; raw data in build/r7-session-cleanup.json

interpretationCorrection.cause: Hyprland 0.56.2 mapWindow initializes dim_percent from dim_strength even with dim_inactive=false. The initial fixture inherited dim_strength=0.5; BWM appearance.lua uses 0.05.
interpretationCorrection.opacityField: The recorded values are normalized color contrast. During initial dim animation they do not equal window alpha.
interpretationCorrection.openingDurationAndCoupling: The initial interpretation as desynchronized alpha/geometry was incomplete. These estimates include the changing brightness tint.
interpretationCorrection.supersededBy: BREEZE_R7_SCALE_RESULTS.json with fadeDim disabled and in-memory dim/alpha trace; original raw samples preserved.
